rules.interpretation: Number 1 represents Communication, verbal expression, career foundation, and vital fluidity. Associated with the Water element.
rules.exceptions: Subject to repetition tier and element balance.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: Number 1 corresponds to Communication and Water element.

rules.interpretation: Number 2 represents Intuition and sensitive power, emotional receptivity, and diplomatic awareness. Associated with the Earth element.
rules.exceptions: Excessive repetition leads to hypersensitivity.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: Number 2 corresponds to Intuition/Sensitive Power and Earth element.

rules.interpretation: Number 3 represents Creativity and imagination, intellectual expansion, and optimistic thinking. Associated with the Wood element.
rules.exceptions: Unbalanced repetitions may disperse creative focus.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: Number 3 corresponds to Creativity/Imagination and Wood element.

rules.interpretation: Number 4 represents Discipline and organised power, practical execution, structure, and methodical diligence. Associated with the Wood element.
rules.exceptions: Rigidity may emerge under high repetition tiers.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: Number 4 corresponds to Discipline/Organised Power and Wood element.

rules.interpretation: Number 5 represents Balance, adaptability, emotional equilibrium, and central anchoring. Associated with the central Earth element.
rules.exceptions: Center of the grid; stabilizes surrounding planes.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: Number 5 corresponds to Balance and central Earth element.

rules.interpretation: Number 6 represents Home, family and love relationships, domestic responsibility, luxury, and artistic beauty. Associated with the Metal element.
rules.exceptions: High repetition may create domestic over-protectiveness or worry.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: Number 6 corresponds to Home/Family/Love Relationships and Metal element.

rules.attribute_name: Disappointment, healing, wisdom, spirituality and the divine
rules.interpretation: Number 7 represents Disappointment through worldly attachments turning into healing, wisdom, spirituality, research, and connection to the divine. Associated with the Metal element.
rules.exceptions: Initial worldly loss acts as a gateway to spiritual or technical mastery.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: Number 7 corresponds to Disappointment/Healing/Wisdom/Spirituality and Metal element.

rules.interpretation: Number 8 represents Money and finance management, material assets, organizational accountability, perseverance, and karma. Associated with the Earth element.
rules.exceptions: Rewards come with methodical diligence; requires proper management structure.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: Number 8 corresponds to Money/Finance Management and Earth element.

rules.interpretation: Number 9 represents Aggression, ego, humanity, idealism, and the cultivation of humility. Associated with the Fire element.
rules.exceptions: Higher repetitions elevate ego/temper unless channeled into humanitarian service.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: Number 9 corresponds to Aggression/Ego/Humanity/Humility and Fire element.

rules.interpretation: Single occurrence denotes basic or under-expressed potential of the attribute; functional but requires conscious development.
rules.exceptions: Depends on the specific number and overall chart harmony.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: 1 occurrence = Under.

rules.interpretation: Two occurrences form a balanced Pair, described by the instructor as the best-performing and most harmonious energetic strength.
rules.exceptions: Best performing; balanced expression without excess friction.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: 2 occurrences = Pair (Best-performing).

rules.interpretation: Three occurrences create an Exaggerate state, where the traits become dominant, vocal, or magnified beyond normal boundaries.
rules.exceptions: Not automatically negative; depends on whether supportive elements exist.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: 3 occurrences = Exaggerate.

rules.interpretation: Four occurrences produce a Reactive condition, marked by sudden behavioral volatility, sensitivity to triggers, or acute defensiveness.
rules.exceptions: Requires remedial harmonization to reduce friction.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: 4 occurrences = Reactive.

rules.interpretation: Five occurrences yield an Over-reactive (or hyper-reactive) intensity, where the native experiences extreme internal or external pressure regarding that number.
rules.exceptions: Rare intensity; requires dedicated lifestyle remedies.
rules.provenance: Day 7 transcript: 5 occurrences = Over-reactive / Hyper-reactive.

rules.interpretation: Frequencies above 5 are explicitly not established in the Day 7 source. The system strictly abstains from extrapolating beyond 5 occurrences.
rules.exceptions: Strict abstention boundary.
rules.provenance: Directive: Do not extrapolate beyond five occurrences until applicable source rule is available.
